tool.title: Is this repository's cutover from the monorepo complete? Measured, condition by condition
tool.description: Run in a separated repository. Six conditions, each decided by an existing gate: `mounts` (every declared layer on disk at its pin — `remote-mount --check`), `declarations` (every path a declaration names resolves — `declaration-resolution`), `monorepo-paths` (no wiring still names the monorepo: `livesAt` on it, a submodule of it, a reusable workflow called from it, a path into its old checkout — the one condition implemented here), `import-direction` and `reference-direction` (no layer reaches a layer above it), and `site` (the site builds from the mounts alone, every link resolving — `build-instance-site --no-mount`, only with `--site`). Findings inside a MOUNTED layer are listed and not counted: a defect in a layer pinned from upstream is fixed upstream and re-pinned. Exit 0 complete, 1 a condition failed, 2 a condition could not be determined or was not run — without `--site` the answer is never 0.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: The separated checkout. Default: the working directory.

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: Build the site from the mounts on disk (minutes); without it the `site` condition is not run and the verdict cannot be complete.

inputs.name: monorepo
inputs.description: The repository the separation left, `<owner>/<repo>`. Default: litlfred/folio-assistant.

inputs.name: monorepoDir
inputs.description: Its old checkout directory name, as paths spell it. Default: the repository's name.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: Print the report as JSON, mounted-layer findings included.

outputs.name: conditions
outputs.description: Per condition: pass, fail, could-not-determine or not-run, the gate that decided it, and its findings.

selection.when: Before calling a separation's cutover (kg-separation stage 13) done, and after any re-pin of a separated repository's layers.
selection.limits: It judges ONE repository. A downstream's own CI and the parent repository's retirement are not observed from here.
selection.cost: Seconds without `--site`; a full Jekyll build with it.

$comment.comment:
Owner, 2026-10-12 (task 6): "a check that proves a repo's cutover from
the monorepo is complete — measure it, do not assume it". The gate after
kg-separation stage 13 (processes/kg/kg-separation.bpmn, GW_CutoverComplete).
